correctness.rationale: The power formula telescopes exactly. Each shifted output dyadic block meets at most two input blocks and has a sharp, finite source-budget maximization. The singleton output contributes n+1. For a>=4 all other candidates are strictly below the winner by 2+9n/20, and for a=2 dyadic crossings occur at n=1,5,13,...; only n=1,5 can exceed n+1. Rational values are 17/6 and 37/6. The winning output block is unique, forcing the two stated norm-attaining vector criteria. This is a complete proof for each integer n>=1 and each real 1<=p<infinity, not an extrapolation from tests. Verification code checks finite cases only.
